description: Spell a scale on letters from a tonic. Major, minor, harmonic minor, melodic minor (the ascending form), the church modes, pentatonic, minor pentatonic, and blues. G# major is written with E# and F##, not with flats. signature lists the accidentals in scale order. The octave does not repeat the tonic. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/music-scale
